authoring.note: Cornelis Schuytstraat 7-15 (odd), between the Willemsparkweg and the Van Breestraat: the 1897 row of four (9-15) under one deep white entablature and slate mansards with tall stone dormers, white segmental hoods over the first-floor windows, jack-block heads and painted bands; 7 (1894) a storey-line lower. Shops: Bodes & Bode (7), a refitted shop (9), the florist Menno Kroon (11), Marlies Dekkers (13).
